objective: Upgrade merchant operations using researched Zatiq, Bitcommerz, Sellsull and StoreX patterns
acceptance_criteria: Document primary-source comparison and implemented/deferred features
Customer directory supports server search/pagination and bounded order history without cross-tenant access
Date-filtered reports show accurate delivered values, discounts, statuses, daily totals and top delivered products in Asia/Dhaka
Order filters/export agree; CSV escapes spreadsheet formulas and Unicode correctly
Authenticated printable invoices use saved order snapshots and totals
New routes work on desktop/mobile with loading/error/empty states
PostgreSQL regressions, browser workflows and production build pass on the updated local stack
non_goals: Traffic or abandoned-cart tracking without an implemented event pipeline
Copying competitor code, logos or promotional claims
